en: Dependent on a state that is non-non-condition, non-visible, and impinging, there arises a state that is with condition, visible, and impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One for root; one for predominance … pe … one for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-non-condition, non-visible, and impinging, there arises a state that is with condition, invisible, and impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One for root; one for predominance … pe … one for non-disappearance.
(There is also only one [condition] in the root of non-arising, non-conditioned, non-demonstrable, and non-reactive. Under root: one; under predominance: one … pe … under non-disappearance: one.
(The non-conditioned is similar to the non-arising.)
